scorers.description: These are the scorers used to evaluate the test.

type.description: This is the type of the test, which must be chat.

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the test.

testSuiteId.description: This is the unique identifier for the test suite this test belongs to.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the organization this test belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the test was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the test was last updated.

name.description: This is the name of the test.

script.description: This is the script to be used for the chat test.

numAttempts.description: This is the number of attempts allowed for the test.
